$comment: Product catalog. Single source of truth for model/part identifiers used by the request forms, the parts reference, and the firmware manifest.

units.name: Erektor ER-4H (Heavy)
units.notes: Heavy-duty four-leg platform. Uses reinforced cylinders; LEG-A2 is NOT a valid substitute.

units.name: Erektor ER-6
units.notes: Six-leg platform with independent centre-pair levelling. Leg positions 1-6.

units.name: Erektor ER-4C (Legacy)
units.notes: Support-only. LEG-A1 is superseded by LEG-A2 with adapter kit KIT-A1A2. EC-5 controllers do not accept remote updates.

legAssemblies.name: Leg Assembly A3
legAssemblies.notes: Integrated absolute position transducer; self-identifies to the controller on connect.

serialFormat.description: Model, build year, then a five-digit sequence. Found on the frame plate above leg 1 and on the controller About screen.
